description: This file contains a script for analyzing GitHub pull requests, extracting contributor data, and updating contributor-related YAML files in a documentation project. It uses the GitHub GraphQL API, processes pull request data, maintains counters for contributors, and automates the creation of a pull request with updated contributor information.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: LabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node associated with a pull request.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Contains a list of label nodes for a pull request.

classes.name: ReviewNode
classes.description: Represents a review on a pull request, including reviewer info and review state.

classes.name: Reviews
classes.description: Contains a list of review nodes for a pull request.

classes.name: PullRequestNode
classes.description: Represents a GitHub pull request with detailed metadata, including authors, labels, reviews, and states.

classes.name: PullRequestEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the GraphQL response, including the cursor and the pull request node.

classes.name: PullRequests
classes.description: Contains a list of pull request edges.

classes.name: PRsRepository
classes.description: Encapsulates the repository data with its pull requests.

classes.name: PRsResponseData
classes.description: Holds the main data part of the GraphQL response.

classes.name: PRsResponse
classes.description: Represents the top-level structure of the GraphQL API response.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration for GitHub API access, including token, repository, and optional timeout.

classes.name: ContributorsResults
classes.description: Holds counts and author info for contributors, translators, and reviewers found in PRs.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST to the GitHub GraphQL API with the provided query and variables, returning the JSON response.

methods.name: list[PullRequestEdge] get_graphql_pr_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pull request edges from the GitHub GraphQL API, handling pagination.

methods.name: list[PullRequestNode] get_pr_nodes(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Collects and returns all pull request nodes from the repository, paginated over PRs.

methods.name: ContributorsResults get_contributors(pr_nodes: list[PullRequestNode])
methods.description: Analyzes pull requests to compile counters of contributors, translators, and reviewers, along with author info.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_users_to_write( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Filters contributors based on minimum count and assembles their display information.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Reads existing YAML content, compares with new content, and updates the file if changed.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that coordinates fetching PR data, updating contributor YAML files, and creating a GitHub pull request for updates.
